releaseNotes: Added opt-in privacy-first Automatic Payment Detection across Google Pay India, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, Google Wallet, and major banking apps (with in-app privacy disclosure before opening Android Notification Access settings, plus Share-to-Track & Smart Paste fallbacks).

Detected payments land strictly as PENDING_REVIEW without auto-guessing category or spending purpose, feature a Pending Review card on Home, support Unassigned Account state, prevent duplicates/double-deductions across updated notifications and UPI Ref IDs, and reject failed/declined alerts.

Added a single-layer Review & Classify sheet (category, spending purpose, merchant, account, amount correction, notes) for confirming pending payments and editing confirmed transactions anytime, while keeping raw notification metadata strictly on-device (Room v4).
